parts.name: Root
parts.description: A native input element with modality-aware focus state and validation data attributes.

props.name: invalid
props.description: Marks the value as invalid: maps to `aria-invalid` and `data-invalid`.

props.name: element
props.description: Bindable reference to the rendered input element.

dataAttributes.name: data-focus-visible
dataAttributes.description: Present while focus should be visibly indicated (keyboard modality).

dataAttributes.name: data-focused
dataAttributes.description: Present while the element has focus.

dataAttributes.name: data-hovered
dataAttributes.description: Present while the pointer is over the element.

dataAttributes.name: data-invalid
dataAttributes.description: Present when the value is marked invalid.
